result.topic_en: Calculations eliminating variables from the relation $\sqrt{xy}+\sqrt{zt}+\sqrt{uv}=0$ by a parameter s, computing Jacobian-type determinants for the differential $dx/(\partial X/\partial y)$, followed by algebraic manipulations with auxiliary quantities p, q, r, v, alpha, beta; a faint Italian note runs vertically along the right margin.
result.transcription:
$\varphi(x,y,s)=0$
$\psi(x,y,s)=0$
$\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}dx+\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial y}dy+\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial s}ds$
$\frac{dx}{\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial s}-\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial s}\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial y}}=\frac{ds}{\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial x}}$
$X=\sqrt{xy}+\sqrt{zt}+\sqrt{uv}=0$
$\frac{dx}{\frac{\partial X}{\partial y}}=\frac{dx}{8\sqrt{xy}\sqrt{zt}\sqrt{uv}}$ [-$\partial\sqrt{xy}+\partial\sqrt{zt}$-] $\frac{\partial X}{\partial y}$
$\sqrt{zt}=s\sqrt{xy}$
$\sqrt{uv}=-(1+s)\sqrt{xy}$
$zt-s^2xy=\varphi=0$ $\quad 2sxy+xy-uv+zt=0$
$uv-(1+s)^2xy=\psi=0$
$\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial zt}{\partial y}-s^2\frac{\partial xy}{\partial y}\quad\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial s}=-2(1+s)xy=2\sqrt{uvxy}$ {+$+2s(1+s)xy\frac{\partial xy}{\partial y}$+}
$\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial uv}{\partial y}-(1+s)^2\frac{\partial xy}{\partial y}\quad\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial s}=-2s(xy)=-2\sqrt{zt\,xy}$
$\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial s}-\frac{\partial\psi}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial s}=4\sqrt{uvxyzt}\left(\frac{\partial\sqrt{zt}}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial\sqrt{uv}}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial\sqrt{xy}}{\partial y}\right)$
$\left(\frac{\partial\sqrt{zt}}{\partial x}-s\frac{\partial\sqrt{xy}}{\partial x}\right)dx+\left(\frac{\partial\sqrt{zt}}{\partial y}-s\frac{\partial\sqrt{xy}}{\partial y}\right)dy-\sqrt{xy}\,ds=0$
$\left(\frac{\partial\sqrt{uv}}{\partial x}+(1+s)\frac{\partial\sqrt{xy}}{\partial x}\right)dx+\left(\frac{\partial\sqrt{uv}}{\partial y}+(1+s)\frac{\partial\sqrt{xy}}{\partial y}\right)dy+\sqrt{xy}\,ds=0$
$\sqrt{xy}+s\sqrt{zt}+p=0$
$xy+2s\sqrt{xyzt}+s^2zt-(p^2+2\alpha pq+\alpha^2q^2)=qr$
$\frac{\sqrt{xy}+s\sqrt{zt}+p}{q}=\frac{r}{\sqrt{xy}+s\sqrt{zt}-p}$
$\frac{v+p}{q}=\frac{r}{v-p}$
$\frac{v+p+\alpha q}{v+p+\beta q}\quad v^2=p^2+qr$
$qr-2\beta pq-\beta^2q^2$
$\frac{v+p+\alpha q}{v+p+\beta q}=$ [-...-] $\frac{v^2+v(\alpha-\beta)q-(p+\alpha q)(p+\beta q)}{q(r-2\beta p-\beta^2q)}=\frac{v(\alpha-\beta)+r-(\alpha+\beta)p-\alpha\beta q}{}$

[right margin, vertical, faint:] Ma, se ha perduto[?], deve pagare per tutto il tempo. Però andare[?] se gli piace
